other_conditions: Student must be studying in Class XI or XII in Higher Secondary Schools affiliated to the Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha (CHSE(O)).
Student must have proficiency in Mathematics.
Student must be enrolled in an Odia‑medium Government, Aided or Recognized institution.
No income or BPL criteria are required for the scholarship.
benefits_summary: Eligible Class XI and XII students receive ₹5,000 per month for 10 months each year.
